complexity.notes: Correct and O(1) extra space, but the repeated `list1.val < list2.val` checks when initializing root/next1/next2 are clunky; a dummy head node would simplify the code and avoid the duplicated comparisons. Also the final if/else both return root, so it could be collapsed to `current.next = next1 or next2; return root`.
complexity.summary: Iterative two-pointer merge: picks the smaller head as root, then walks both lists appending the smaller node each step, and finally attaches the remaining tail of whichever list is non-empty.
